standard_prerequisites.name: The regular-model situation, smoothness at a point and the residue field of a component
standard_prerequisites.statement: The situation fixes a discrete valuation ring with residue field, a smooth projective curve over its fraction field, a regular proper model and the components of the special fibre with their multiplicities; a rational point of the curve extends to a morphism from the spectrum of the ring because the model is proper over it, and the image of the closed point lies on the special fibre. At that image the local ring of the special fibre is obtained by dividing out the uniformizer, its regularity follows from the regularity of the local ring of the model together with the Cohen-Macaulay property, and smoothness at the point follows from regularity combined with separability of the residue extension. The author's own lemmas of the chapter and the quoted results of the Algebra, Morphisms, Schemes and Varieties chapters are the allowed inputs.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted lemma is the computation that the chapter performs whenever the curve has a rational point: it pins down the numerical type of the component through that point and gives the equality of genera used later in the genus formula.

core_obligations: Extend the rational point: the valuative criterion for proper morphisms upgrades the rational point of the curve to a morphism from the spectrum of the discrete valuation ring into the model, and the image of the closed point is a point of the special fibre (source lines 5347-5352).

Prove regularity and smoothness at that point: dividing the local ring of the model at the image by the uniformizer gives the local ring of the special fibre there, which is regular by the Cohen-Macaulay property of the regular local ring, hence the special fibre is smooth at the point by the separability criterion, and the point lies on a unique component (source lines 5352-5360).

Read off the numerical data: the point being smooth and rational on a unique component forces the multiplicity of that component to be one and its residue field to be the residue field of the ring, so the numerical type of the special fibre carries that information (source lines 5360-5368).

Conclude the global assertions: the structure sheaf of the special fibre has the residue field as its global sections and the genus of the special fibre equals the genus of the curve, which the chapter's lemma on the field and the comparison of genera supply (source lines 5368-5372).

proof_roadmap.step: Extend the rational point to the model by the valuative criterion.
Show the special fibre is smooth at the image and that the point lies on one component.
Read the multiplicity and the residue field off the smooth rational point.
Conclude the global sections and the equality of genera.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 Stacks Project 章 models.tex 的 Lemma lemma-numerical-type-rational-point（源 5332-5344 行，证明 5346-5372 行，27 行）：设 C 有 K-有理点，则特纤维有 k-有理光滑点 x，且若 x∈C_i 则 H^0(C_i,O)=k、m_i=1，并且 H^0(X_k,O)=k、g(X_k)=g(C)。关键操作不是例行核验：证明要用**优赋值判据**把有理点提升为 Spec(R)→X 的态射（5347-5352 行），再逐点验证特纤维在像点的局部环正则（用正则局部环的 CM 性）并据此得光滑（5352-5360 行），随后由「光滑 + 有理点 + 唯一分支」推出 m_i=1 与残域即 k（5360-5368 行），最后用本章的域引理与亏格比较收全局两条（5368-5372 行）。难点在于把「有理点」这一整条信息穿过优赋值判据与局部环计算两层，并逐项落到数值类型上；原文位置在证明的 5347-5352、5352-5360、5360-5368、5368-5372 行。
